segments.he:
א'
ומהיום והלאה נתחיל לעבוד את השם־יתברך על־ידי העצות הקדושות אשר גילה לנו רבינו ז"ל, שלפחות מעתה נהיה 'ערליכר יוד' (=יהודים יראי שמים) באמת. (מכתב ב')
segments.en: "Make for yourself a teacher" — and if you do not know to whom — "acquire for yourself a friend" — attach yourself to the pen. At any rate — each day to study some Torah from the Torah of Rabbainu — whose soul and wisdom are in his holy books — and to pray a little for fulfillment. (Letter 49)

segments.he:
ב'
ואחר כך נזכרתי הלא יש לנו כל כך הרבה ספרים מרבינו ומתלמידיו הקדושים, ואיפה שפותחים יהיה איפה שיהיה נתעוררים מאוד על־ידי־זה. (מכתב ה')
segments.en: And especially one who merits to innovate in the books — this is the delight of the World to Come. And especially in these halachos of the true Tzaddik — which is all true seed. And also the innovations of his holy disciple Reb Noson — who draws and gives drink from the Torah of his master — who is unique in his generation in the matter of saying the Torah. And it is known that his holy language is very easy to understand. Turn them over and turn them over as much as possible — since only these will save. Happy are we that we merited to such a light — pure and radiant. (Letter 156)

segments.he:
ג'
ובאמת אנו צריכים ללמוד הרבה 'ליקוטי הלכות' בכל יום ויום כדי לשאוב התחזקות, וגם כן להכיר גדולת ספר 'ליקוטי מוהר"ן'. (מכתב ח')

ד'
וגם ללמוד כל יום ספרי רבינו שזה פותח גידי קַשיות ליבנו לבל ניתן ימינו ושנותינו להבל ולריק. (מכתב י"א)
segments.en: With what shall we come before Hashem — for all that He has bestowed upon us — that He gave us the Torah of truth and planted eternal life within us. And now Hashem our G-d — whose kindnesses are from eternity to eternity upon us — may Your innards tremble over us. And just as You had compassion upon us and gave us Your holy Torah — hidden treasure — delight of each day — so may You grant us merit and be our help that we all merit to learn and to engage in Your holy Torah for its own sake always. And we turn our faces away from the vanities of this world entirely — but only in the Torah of Hashem shall be our desire — and in Your Torah we shall contemplate day and night. And all our study shall be in holiness and purity — and all our intention shall be only for Your great and holy Name in truth. And we shall merit to learn and to teach, to guard, to do, and to fulfill all the words of Your Torah in love. And help us so that the light of the holy Torah shall illuminate for us — to bring us out from darkness to light — to return us in complete teshuvah before You. As our Sages said: "The illumination that is in it returns one to the good."

segments.he:
ה'
מה אומר לך, יש לנו עצה נפלאה מאוד איך למאוס בכל תאוות העולם הזה והבליו, - בפשיטות גמור לקחת את ספר 'ליקוטי מוהר"ן' וללמוד תורה אחר תורה, ולהכניס התורה בפנימיות הלב, ולילך עם התורה הזאת. (מכתב י"ח)
segments.en: Please Hashem — help us so that the study of the holy Torah shall become for us a life-giving elixir — that we merit through our study to return in complete teshuvah before You in truth. And to renew like an eagle our youth. And may the merit and power of the holy Torah protect us — to save us from all kinds of sins and flaws — both in the time when we engage in it and when we are compelled not to. As our holy Sages said: "Oraisa megina u'matzla bein b'idana d'asik bah u'vein b'idana d'la asik bah" [the Torah protects and saves both during the time one engages in it and when one does not]. And we merit that holiness and purity be drawn upon us through the study of the holy Torah — as is Your good will.

segments.he:
ו'
ונהיה בעזרת השם־יתברך מקורבים לרבינו ולקיים ולעסוק בספרי רבינו ז"ל, ולומר הרבה 'ליקוטי תפילות' בלי שיעור. (מכתב כ"ד)
segments.en: Please Hashem — merciful One full of mercy — have compassion upon me and upon all Your people the house of Yisrael at this time — for we have greatly descended with none to help us. And we have no life-force or restorer of soul to give life to our very wretched souls — except through the study of Your holy and pure and wholesome Torah — which illuminates the eyes and restores the soul. As You promised us — that even in these end of days — in the force of the concealment within the concealment — even then the Torah will not be forgotten from our mouths and the mouths of our offspring. As it is written: "And I will surely conceal My face from them..." "and this song will testify before Him — for it will not be forgotten from the mouth of his offspring." And behold now — already it has been fulfilled in us — "And I will surely conceal My face" — for You have hidden from us greatly — in concealment within concealment — in thousands and tens of thousands of concealments. And therefore may Your great mercy and kindness be aroused upon us — and do not continue to conceal Your face from us. Turn to us and be gracious to us and illuminate Your face upon us. And fulfill for us Your holy promise — "for it will not be forgotten from the mouth of his offspring." And help us in Your mercy — that we merit to learn and contemplate and persevere in Your holy Torah day and night — in holiness and purity — we and our children and our children's children — and the Torah will not be forgotten from our mouths forever. And may the verse be fulfilled: "And I — this is My covenant with them, says Hashem — My spirit that is upon you and My words that I have placed in your mouth shall not depart from your mouth nor from the mouth of your offspring nor from the mouth of your offspring's offspring — says Hashem — from now and forever." And we merit through the study of the holy Torah to return to You in truth — and to return in complete teshuvah before You for all our many sins and iniquities. And we merit from now to fulfill all the words of Your Torah in love. And You arouse Your mercies upon us — and pour upon us Your holiness. And grant us merit that we study in great holiness Your holy Torah — the Written and Oral Torah — until we merit in the time of study to bind our spirit with the spirit of the Tzaddik who innovated this Torah and this halachah that we are studying. Until we merit to the aspect of the holy kiss — to attach our spirit in the spirit of the Tzaddik. And we cause great delight to this Tzaddik — so that his lips speak softly in the grave — through our study of his holy words in great holiness. And we merit to raise up the Shechinah from the dust — to raise the Shechinah from the exile through our study in great holiness and purity.

segments.he:
ז'
הבה נשליך את עצמנו לתוך ה"נחל נובע מקור חכמה", ובעיקר ללמוד הרבה ספרי רבינו ז"ל - כדי לידע מה לקיים. ובאמת גם הלימוד ספרי רבינו ז"ל זה קיום גדול, שרצון רבינו ז"ל שנלך עם תורותיו, ו"הלימוד מביא לידי מעשה". (מכתב כ"ו)
segments.en: Please Hashem — full of mercy — have compassion upon our wretched souls. And save us — that the study of the Torah not become for us, G-d forbid, a deadly poison. That there not enter our heart, G-d forbid, any aspect of opposition against true Tzaddikim through our studies. Please Hashem — save and deliver us — that no aspect of arrogance and haughtiness enter our heart. And let there be in our heart no doubts and objections against the true Tzaddikim of the generation. But on the contrary — grant us merit to bind and to draw near to true Tzaddikim — to be submissive before them — and to believe in them and to nullify before them — and to drink thirstily their holy words — all the days of my life — I and my offspring and my offspring's offspring and all Your people the house of Yisrael — from now and forever. And grant us merit to bind and to draw near to true Tzaddikim — great in level exceedingly — who have the power to elevate and to overturn all the evil combinations of words that are spoken against the true Tzaddikim — to overturn them toward holiness. And we merit to raise the Shechinah from the exile — and to join her with her Beloved in love and brotherhood and friendship. And subdue and break and nullify all those who dispute against the truth. And put in their hearts truth and faith — and they all return to You in truth and with a whole heart. And reveal and publicize the truth in the world. And fulfill the verse: "Truth shall spring from the earth and righteousness shall look down from Heaven." And make peace among all Your people Yisrael forever. And grant me merit to serve You in joy always. And help me to be among those who are insulted and do not insult — who hear their shame and do not respond — who act out of love and rejoice in suffering. And be gracious to us from Yourself with wisdom, understanding, and knowledge. And we all merit to study Your holy Torah for its own sake always — and we return to You in truth. And pour upon us abundant blessings from the source of blessings. And we merit to do Your will in truth all the days of our lives — we and our offspring and all Your people the house of Yisrael — from now and forever — Amen, Selah.

segments.he:
ח'
לכן אנו צריכים להסתכל בשכל זה, דהיינו, בעצות וספרי רבינו, כדי שיאיר לנו השכל אפילו במקום אפל וחשוך לידע איך להתחזק ולצאת בכל מקום שהוא וכו'. הבה נשתמש בהם בפשיטות ללמוד ספרי רבינו ולהאמין שיש בכל דיבור ודיבור אורות שיאירו לנו הדרך איך להתנהג. (מכתב ל"א)
segments.en: תם ונשלם, שבח לאל בורא עולםCompleted and finished — praise to G-d Creator of the world

segments.he:
ט'
תדע ידידי שרבינו ז"ל הוא השדכן, כמו שרבינו ז"ל אומר ב'ליקוטי מוהר"ן' "הדעת משדך כל השידוכים".
לכן צריך אתה ללמוד הרבה דעת רבינו ז"ל, היינו ספריו הקדושים. (מכתב ל"ב)

י'
אי אפשר לומר דבר, רק צריכים להרבות בספרי רבינו ז"ל שיאיר השם את עינינו לילך בדרך התורה בקדושה וטהרה כרצון השם־יתברך וכרצון יראיו. (מכתב מ"ו)
